title: A Russian drone hits a house in Romania

paragraphs: Last weekend, a Russian drone hit a big apartment building in the Romanian city of Galați. The explosion injured a woman and a child, and local people were very scared.

Romania sent fast fighter jets to help, but they couldn’t shoot the drone down. The city is very close to the border with Ukraine, so the army had only a few minutes to see the drone and react. Experts also say that fast jets are not the right tool for small, slow drones. If pilots shoot them over a big city, dangerous broken pieces could fall and hurt more people.

Russian drones crossed borders before, but this is the first time a drone injures citizens in a NATO country. Now, Romania is asking NATO to send better defense weapons quickly to close the gaps and protect the people.

words.d: to do or say something because of something else that just happened
a person who officially belongs to a city or country
protection against attack, danger, or harm

paragraphs: A Russian drone hits a big house in a Romanian city. It causes a big fire and hurts a woman and a child. The people in the city are very afraid now.

Romania sends jets to stop it, but they are too late. The city is very close to the country of Ukraine. The drone comes too fast. Also, the big planes are not good at hitting small, slow drones. If they shoot over the city, pieces can fall on people.
This is the first time a drone hurts people in this country. Now, Romania is talking to NATO. They want more help and better weapons to stay safe.

A Russian drone crashed into a 10-story residential building in the Romanian city of Galați overnight, and injured a woman and a child. This incident caused great panic among local citizens, who now feel unsafe.

Romania quickly scrambled F-16 fighter jets, and the pilots had permission to shoot, but they couldn’t destroy the drone in time. Officials explained that the city is located very close to the Ukrainian border, which gave the military only a few minutes to react. Furthermore, advanced fighter jets like the F-16 are designed for air combat, which makes it very difficult to target small, low-flying, and slow drones. Shooting them down over a large city could also cause dangerous debris to fall on civilians.

While Moscow denied the drone was Russian, Romania is now urgently demanding more NATO air defense equipment. NATO is taking the situation very seriously, as drone incursions into member states like Latvia and Lithuania are happening more frequently.

words.d: a sudden, strong feeling of fear that makes you unable to think clearly or act calmly
to order military aircraft to take off immediately to check or stop an enemy threat
scattered fragments or broken pieces of something that has been destroyed or exploded
a sudden invasion or movement into another country’s territory or airspace without permission
